protocol:
1. Set up the bench with a green ice bucket containing labeled small PCR tubes, tube racks, a handheld micropipette, an open blue tip box, and nearby reaction tubes and plates.

2. Attach a disposable pipette tip from the open blue tip box to the handheld micropipette.

3. Remove a labeled PCR tube from the ice bucket and hold it in the gloved hand while keeping the remaining tubes on ice.

4. Open the PCR tube and pipette liquid into the tube using the handheld micropipette and disposable tip.

5. Return the handled PCR tube to the ice bucket or nearby tube rack after pipetting.

6. Repeat the pipetting workflow with additional labeled PCR tubes from the ice bucket, using the micropipette and disposable tips.

7. Cap the prepared PCR tube by hand to seal the reaction mixture.

8. Place the capped PCR tube into a small benchtop mini-centrifuge rotor and close the centrifuge lid.

9. Briefly centrifuge the capped PCR tube in the mini-centrifuge to collect liquid at the bottom of the tube.

10. Move the centrifuged PCR tube to the thermal cycler area and use the Bio-Rad T100 Thermal Cycler touchscreen to clear the existing prompt.

11. Open the Bio-Rad T100 Thermal Cycler lid and place the prepared PCR tube or tube strip into the sample block.

12. Close the Bio-Rad T100 Thermal Cycler lid, select the thermal cycling program on the touchscreen, and start the run.
